item.tib: dpal gsang bdag gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang mchong gsang dbang snying gi thig le
item.coloph: de ltar gsas mkhar gsang ba sga (sgo) dgu'i bdag nyid chen po bon nyid theg dgu gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang chog gsang ba snying gi thig le 'di yang / gangs can bstan pa'i sgron me gsal dag rig pa rang shar/ sa gsum las 'gran zla bral ba/ ka dag bon gyi skur mngon par brnyes pa'i/ dpal snya chen mngon byon grub dbang bla ma'i gser khri skyong ba'i mchog gi sprul sku/ skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsa ba mkhas pa rin chen blo gsal gyi rnam rol/ mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags kyis bka' gsungs spyi bor phebs pa dang / ma zad mkhas pa'i nor la dbang ba'i drang srong nam mkha' tshul khrims dang drang srong dbang 'dus sogs kyis lha rdzas dri med kyis mtshams sbyar nas bskul ba la brten nas/ deng sang gi gdag byar gyur ba rgod rje rgya yi gdung la dal rten rnyed pa'i drang srong g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag gis/ g.yung drung bon gyi 'dus gnas chen po nor bu gling du dkar chag yi ger btab pa'o//

item.tib: dpal gsang bdag gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang mchong gsang dbang snying gi thig le
item.coloph: de ltar gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i bdag nyid chen po bon nyid theg dgu gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang chog gsang ba snying gi thig le 'di yang / gangs can bstan pa'i sgron me gsal dag rig pa rang shar/ sa gsum las 'gran zla bral ba/ ka dag bon gyi sku mngon par brnyes pa'i/ dpal snya chen mngon byon grub dbang bla ma'i gser khrir skyong ba'i mchog gi sprul sku/ skad gnyis smra ba'i lotsa ba mkhas pa rin chen blo gsal gyi rnam rol/ mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags kyis bka' gsung spyi bor phebs (phab) pa dang*/ ma zad nor la dbang ba'i drang srong nam mkha' tshul khrims dang drang srong dbang 'dus sogs kyis lha rdzas dri med kyis mtshams sbyar nas bskul ba la bstan (brten) nas/ deng sang gi gdag byar gyur pa rgod rje rgya yi gdung la dal rten rnyed pa'i drang srong g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag gis/ g.yung drung bon gyi 'du gnas chen po nor bu gling du dkar chag yi ger btab pa'o/ dge des sangs rgyas g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa dar rgyas bstan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
